effective_config.equality: exact raw model feature tuples; signed zeros normalized only

definition.train_excess_duplicate_rows: all train rows except the first member of each global raw-feature equality group; labels excluded
definition.train_within_class_excess_duplicate_rows: excess rows within the stated class, also excluding labels from features
definition.test_matching_any_train_rows: test row whose entire raw feature vector equals any train row, regardless of labels
definition.conflict_rows: all rows belonging to a feature-equality group with at least two distinct labels in the explicitly named scope
definition.conflict_groups: distinct feature-equality groups with conflicting labels; per-class group counts need not add because a group can contain several classes
definition.caps: actual NSL/UNSW raw loader applies no per-class cap; before and after counts are equal
definition.rare_labels: train < 100 or test < 100, including labels absent from one split
definition.decision: 去重重跑 if overall test overlap >= 5% or any model-family overlap >= 20%; otherwise 保持; this audit does not rerun or change data
